name: skill-dupes-v2
description: Sweep the mechanical duplicate residue found by md/journal/migrations/taxonomy-kind-map.md step 0: nodes whose own normalizeAliasName key already matches a *different* node's existing alias (self-alias from before alias normalisation landed, or an old name kept as an alias across a rename/merge). Every op below has an already-VERIFIED target — the non-VERIFIED sibling merges into it, which is the same direction the existing alias already encodes. Pairs where neither side is VERIFIED are left untouched (no valid merge target under TaxonomyService.mergeInto's own rule) and are not part of this plan.

phases.title: alias-normalization residue
phases.why: Each pair's alias table already resolves the two names to one concept (via a prior rename or an earlier merge); the extractor re-created the non-VERIFIED side after that fact. Merging closes the gap without asserting anything new.
